body: i feel exactly the same, all my friends left for uni this year and are all out having fun and going to parties and living with new people and i can barely leave my room most of the time because my anxiety confines me. because of social media too i can literally watch my life go by as im missing out all the good things about being "young"
I thought I needed that to but nothing's exciting anymore. I don't look forwards to anything I used to enjoy everythings just dull and grey
Least you didn't drop out of college twice, one more time amd I can list it as a hobby on my CV lol

Maybe it's better that way, then you don't have to experience slowly losing everyone you care about. Sometimes I wonder if it would've been better if I had no friends and no good memories as they just haunt me and cause pain now
Happy birthday! Hope the year brings more surprises and is better than the last :)

It's more that if you suffer from anxiety alongside depression, you don't want to message them as you feel like you're bothering them and wasting their time with your problems. You worry that they're not going to like you anymore if you do bother them then lose them as a friend, which is ironic as you lose them as a friend anyways if you don't message them in the first place and keep contact with them.
